title: John Glenn's 'fireflies' were ice crystals

tellings.quote: or like uh John Glenn, you know, with the the little ice crystals ice crystals.

plain: The "fireflies" the astronaut John Glenn reported seeing outside his capsule during his 1962 orbit of Earth aboard Friendship 7 were little ice crystals, according to the skeptic Michael Shermer. He mentions it to Michels in passing, as an example of a strange sight in space that turned out to have an ordinary cause.
